notes: Memento Cloud API (beta) for Memento Database cloud libraries. The vendor's machine spec is the API Blueprint on Apiary, saved verbatim as upstream.apib; openapi.json is a hand conversion of all 9 actions (list/get libraries; list/create/get/edit/delete entries; search entries; upload files) and every example-bearing response is a named schema, with the blueprint's examples kept. Mapping: blueprint HOST https://api.mementodatabase.com/v1/ -> servers[0]; the per-action `token` attribute -> a query apiKey security scheme; [Entry][] model references -> the Entry schema. One addition not in the blueprint: a shared Error schema for default responses, from the live API's 401 body and the adaptor's 403 'API rate limit exceeded' handling (limit: 10 requests/minute). All 6 adaptor operations map to paths, but updateEntry sends PUT to /libraries/{libraryId}/entries/{entryId} while the blueprint documents PATCH (unverifiable without a token); the spec keeps the vendor's PATCH. The earlier stub also had PATCH and lacked delete, search and file upload.
